articles.headline: Cam Skattebo dons custom 'Iron Man' mask for TNF, leads NFL Week 10 arrivals
articles.description: NFL stars continue to turn gameday arrivals into their own weekly fashion showcase.
articles.headlineJa: キャム・スカットボ、TNFに向けて特製「アイアンマン」マスクを着用し、NFL第10週のスタジアム入りを牽引
articles.descriptionJa: NFLのスター選手たちは、試合当日のスタジアム入りを毎週のファッションショーのような場に変え続けている。
articles.body:
Players across the NFL might want to check the forecast before checking the mirror to finalize their Week 10 looks.

The Washington Commanders visit the New York Giants on Thursday night to open the slate, with rain and temperatures in the low 50s expected in East Rutherford, New Jersey. That gives statement raincoats and boots a chance to shine before either team takes the field.

Sunday's arrivals offer plenty of opportunities to layer up. Morning temperatures in the 30s in Green Bay and the 40s in Cleveland could make wool coats, chunky knits and beanies practical additions to the pregame rotation. The chill extends south, too: Atlanta and Nashville are forecast to start Sunday near freezing before warming into the 50s.

Out west, sunglasses could be the accessory of choice. Mostly sunny skies and afternoon temperatures in the 70s in Glendale, Arizona, and upper 60s in Las Vegas favor lighter layers. Arlington, Texas, offers a different picture, with rain and temperatures hovering in the upper 40s -- another reason to give weather-ready outerwear a starring role.

Here are the standout looks from Week 10.

Thursday night's fashion

Cam Skattebo brought plenty of flair to his arrival, sporting a custom Giants-themed Iron Man mask. He paired the silver-and-blue headgear with a black sweatshirt, khaki pants and layered chains.

articles.headline: Rockets' Marcus Smart suspended three games for punch
articles.description: The NBA on Thursday suspended Rockets guard Marcus Smart three games without pay for throwing a punch at Warriors center Charles Bassey.
articles.headlineJa: ロケッツのマーカス・スマート、パンチにより3試合の出場停止処分
articles.descriptionJa: NBAは木曜日、ウォリアーズのセンター、チャールズ・バッセイにパンチを繰り出したロケッツのガード、マーカス・スマートに対し、無給での3試合出場停止処分を下した。
articles.body:
The NBA on Thursday suspended Houston Rockets guard Marcus Smart three games without pay for throwing a punch at Golden State Warriors center Charles Bassey.

Smart grazed Bassey's nose with a right hook during a confrontation late in the third quarter of Houston's 115-108 home win Wednesday night. Smart was assessed a flagrant foul 2 and ejected.

Smart will miss games Friday at home against the Utah Jazz, Sunday at the Washington Wizards and Monday at the Miami Heat.

The 12-year veteran joined Houston over the summer in free agency, and is averaging 8.6 points, 2.6 rebounds and 1.1 steals over nine games with one start.

The Rockets are 9-3 and in third place in the Western Conference entering play Thursday.

Smart and Bassey engaged in the third quarter Wednesday night after Rockets guard Amen Thompson barreled to the rim for a transition bucket that extended Houston's lead with 21 seconds left. In the aftermath of the play, Smart and Bassey stood face to face jawing as Warriors forward Yaxel Lendeborg attempted to separate them.

Smart threw a right hook that grazed Bassey's nose as he stepped back to slip the punch. The incident took place in front of referee Mitchell Ervin. Thompson and Golden State's Gui Santos and Brandin Podziemski quickly intervened to separate the players along with referee Brandon Adair.

Rockets coach Ime Udoka said after the game that he spoke to Smart, who said he and Bassey got wrapped up and his previously injured elbow got bent.

"So he said something to him, and Bassey said, 'What you gonna do?' and he did it," Udoka said.

Bassey said Smart was playing dirty "the whole game" and called the punch "fake toughness."

"I remember the first half, I was trying to set a screen [and] he grabbed my knee. He was playing dirty," Bassey said. "I think I was trying to get a rebound. He was grabbing my hand, and I was trying to run back on defense. Then, he got up on me and just swung. Obviously, that was weak. I just think that was, honestly, fake toughness.

"It didn't surprise me. I knew he was going to do something. I don't think he was trying to play. I think he was trying to get himself out of the game. I think he was trying to chill. He wasn't trying to hoop. That was fake toughness."

ESPN's Michael C. Wright contributed to this report.

articles.headline: Steelers and Bengals meet for AFC North lead on Sunday night, both 6-2
articles.description: Joe Burrow and the Cincinnati Bengals have been on a record run during their four-game winning streak.
articles.headlineJa: 日曜夜、AFC北地区首位を争うスティールズとベンガルズが激突、両チームともに6勝2敗
articles.descriptionJa: ジョー・バロウ率いるシンシナティ・ベンガルズは、4連勝中で記録的な快進撃を続けている。
articles.body:
Joe Burrow and the Cincinnati Bengals have been on a record run during their four-game winning streak. 


              The only things that may slow them down heading into Sunday night's AFC North showdown against the Pittsburgh Steelers are the NFL scheduling office and jet lag.


              The Bengals and Steelers are tied atop the division with a 6-2 record. Cincinnati is off to its best start since 2015 after a 31-17 victory over the Atlanta Falcons in Madrid. It is also the first time they have won four straight and scored at least 30 points.


              Pittsburgh has won four straight and five of its past six. It comes into the game rested after having its bye last week.


              Teams are 5-0 when coming off a bye and their opponent played the week before in an international game. It is 3-0 when that opponent's game was in Europe. This is the second straight year the Steelers are coming off a bye and facing a team that played internationally. 


              Even though the Bengals are fighting history, coach Zac Taylor does think facing a division opponent offers some benefits.


              “You're able to get started a little quicker because you know the personnel. You’re always going to make sure you comb through the scheme of what they’re doing, and they’ve evolved as the season goes,” Taylor said. 


              Burrow leads the league in completion rate, passing yards per game and passing touchdowns. He passed for 282 yards and three touchdowns during the first meeting on Sept. 27, but Derrick Harmon’s strip-sack on Cincinnati’s final drive allowed Pittsburgh to hold on for a 30-27 victory.


              The seventh-year franchise quarterback has at least three TD passes in each of the past four games. Tee Higgins has hauled in five touchdowns during the Bengals' winning streak, and Ja’Marr Chase has 32 receptions for 435 yards and four touchdowns.


              “Some guys would rather play at 1. I’d rather play every game, Sunday night, ‘Monday Night Football.’ I want to be able to showcase what we do and how hard we work. This is a big moment for it,” Burrow said.


              The Bengals' defense has struggled against the run and when going up against Jaylen Warren. The Steelers' fifth-year running back has two 100-yard games in the past three meetings against the Bengals, who are 25th in the league in run defense and allowing an NFL-high 5.04 yards per carry.


              Warren is in the midst of a career year and leads the NFL with 5.92 yards per carry. He had 176 yards from scrimmage in the first meeting with Cincinnati.


              Pittsburgh's passing game has struggled to generate much downfield, but Aaron Rodgers could get one of his top options back this week in wide receiver Michael Pittman, who has been sidelined the past four weeks because of a foot injury.

articles.headline: Jack Grealish issues public apology after making Everton comeback in friendly
articles.description: Jack Grealish has issued a public apology to Everton fans after he made his comeback in a behind-closed-doors match with Derby.
articles.headlineJa: ジャック・グリーリッシュ、親善試合でのエヴァートン復帰後、公に謝罪
articles.descriptionJa: ジャック・グリーリッシュは、ダービーとの非公開試合で復帰したことを受け、エヴァートンのファンに向けて公に謝罪した。
articles.body:
Jack Grealish has issued a public apology to Everton fans after he made his comeback in a behind-closed-doors match with Derby.

Grealish has missed four matches and not played for Everton since Oct. 17 following a breach of club discipline.

Boss David Moyes has been reluctant to discuss any finer details and the club only confirmed the 31-year-old former England winger was "not match-fit" ahead of a trip to Newcastle on Nov. 2.

But Grealish featured in a friendly at Hill Dickinson Stadium on Thursday in the strongest suggestion yet that a line has been drawn over the issue.

"Nice to be back out there with the boys today after a few good days training," Grealish wrote on his Instagram story.

"I want to apologise to the fans and everyone at the club for not being able to help the team the last few weeks.

- Michael Carrick sacked by Man United; sources say Mauricio Pochettino close

- England mark Harry Kane's night with a win, but defence remains a concern

- Italy beat France at home for first time since '62, hand Zidane 1st loss

"I love playing for this club and can't wait to be back playing in front of you guys in an Everton shirt. See you all soon."

Grealish spent the first half of the 2025-26 campaign on loan at Everton before injury curtailed his spell on Merseyside, but he returned on another temporary deal on transfer deadline day.

articles.headline: Reunion for Jim Harbaugh and Jesse Minter comes with both the Chargers and Ravens spiraling
articles.description: — Jim Harbaugh and Jesse Minter won a national championship together at the college level, then led the Los Angeles Chargers to back-to-back playoff appearances.
articles.headlineJa: ジム・ハーボーとジェシー・ミンターの再会、チャージャーズとレイブンズ両チームが低迷する中で実現
articles.descriptionJa: ジム・ハーボーとジェシー・ミンターは大学時代に共に全米チャンピオンに輝き、その後ロサンゼルス・チャージャーズを2年連続のプレーオフ進出に導いた。
articles.body:
OWINGS MILLS, Md. -- — Jim Harbaugh and Jesse Minter won a national championship together at the college level, then led the Los Angeles Chargers to back-to-back playoff appearances.


              Now they're opponents, each in charge of his own team. And 2026 hasn't been easy for either.


              “I know he’s really motivated to get his team prepared. We’re really motivated to get our team prepared,” Harbaugh said. “It’ll be opposing wills meeting Monday night.”


              When Minter's Baltimore Ravens host Harbaugh's Los Angeles Chargers, it will be a reunion for the two coaches. Minter was Harbaugh's defensive coordinator on Michigan's title-winning staff in 2023, then followed him to the Chargers. Los Angeles won 11 games in each of the past two seasons, but then Minter left to take over the Ravens and now the Chargers are 0-8.


              The Ravens (4-5) haven't been much better of late. They've lost four straight and are set to start their fourth quarterback in the past four weeks.


              The last time these teams faced each other, in 2024, it was a matchup between Jim Harbaugh and his brother John. Now John is coaching the New York Giants, but Chargers-Ravens still includes plenty of familiarity — and two coaches who can relate to each other during a tough season.


              “I love Jim Harbaugh, and a lot of people in that building,” Minter said. “They’re going to work. They’re going to keep their head down. They’re going to search for improvement. They’re going to try to find things each week that they can get better at and try to get better at them. I think he’s a leader through adversity.”


              Baltimore has already had to put quarterbacks Lamar Jackson (thumb) and Tyler Huntley (toe) on injured reserve. Rookie Joe Fagnano started last week in a Thursday night loss to Jacksonville, but the Ravens traded for veteran Jacoby Brissett in the hopes of righting the ship with another primetime game coming up.


              The Ravens will also have their third kicker in three weeks. Tyler Loop (groin) went on IR and was replaced by Jake Moody against the Jaguars. Then Atlanta signed Moody off Baltimore's practice squad, and the Ravens brought in Riley Patterson and Harrison Mevis as kicking options.


              “It means a lot. This is a great organization. The Ravens are very historic,” Patterson said. “A lot of great players have come and played through here, a lot of great kickers. So, I’m excited for the opportunity.”


              There have been few positives for the Chargers, but at least they still have their No. 1 quarterback. Justin Herbert took eight sacks in a loss to Houston last weekend, and he was taken out late in the game with what appeared to be an issue with his non-throwing hand, but imaging came back negative and he's expected to play against Baltimore.


              “He should be good to go,” Harbaugh said.

GLENDALE, Ariz. -- — First-year Arizona Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur is earning his paycheck this week as he works to develop an offensive game plan with a rookie quarterback making his first NFL start, a banged-up offensive line and a group of little-known receivers who have combined for a grand total of eight catches this season.


              On the other side of the field: The Los Angeles Rams and two of the best pass rushers of this generation — Aaron Donald and Myles Garrett.


              “It’s fun," LaFleur said, his voice dripping with sarcasm.


              The Cardinals (3-6) host the Rams (5-4) on Sunday and will be starting rookie quarterback Carson Beck, a third-round draft pick out of Miami. Arizona is trying to snap a 10-game home losing streak that's lasted more than a year.


              Beck was the team's third-string quarterback less than two weeks ago, but has moved into the starting role after Jacoby Brissett was traded to the Baltimore Ravens and Gardner Minshew suffered a season-ending elbow injury against the Seahawks in a loss last weekend.


              LaFleur has leaned into the chaos, embracing the team's underdog status. The Rams are 9 1/2-point favorites.


              “We get to tell new stories, man. As I told the guys today when I started with the quarterbacks — ‘You guys probably didn’t have this on your bingo card two weeks ago, and here we are,'" the coach said. “Different vibes in there, not any better or worse, but it’s the league. You’re never shocked by anything in this league, and here we are.”


              The Rams lost to the Cardinals 18-16 at home on Oct. 18, but have won three straight games since that setback. Los Angeles has a lot of injuries on offense — particularly at receiver with Puka Nacua and Davante Adams battling ailments — but has leaned on its stellar defense to get on a roll.


              Garrett had three sacks in a dominant performance against the Commanders last weekend.

articles.description: — The change came quickly Tuesday, but it was not unexpected when the
articles.headlineJa: レイダーズのQBフェルナンド・メンドーサ、NFL最優秀のシーホークス守備陣を相手に初先発
articles.descriptionJa: 火曜日に急遽変更が発表されたが、それは予想外のことではなかった...
articles.body:
LAS VEGAS -- — The change came quickly Tuesday, but it was not unexpected when the Las Vegas Raiders shipped quarterback Kirk Cousins to Minnesota and installed rookie Fernando Mendoza as their starter.


              As the top draft pick, Mendoza taking over has been anticipated for months by Raiders fans and was a topic of discussion throughout the NFL.


              And what a time to make his debut, going against a Seattle Seahawks defense on Sunday that allows a league-low 244.2 yards per game and puts even the league's top quarterbacks in uncomfortable situations.


              “Every week in the NFL is tough, and this is the best defense in the NFL,” Raiders coach Klint Kubiak said. “(Mendoza's) got to go do his job and not worry about a whole lot else.”


              Kubiak knows all about the Seahawks' defense, going against it in practice last season as Seattle's offensive coordinator.


              He spent just the one season with Seattle, but his offense led by quarterback Sam Darnold and running back Kenneth Walker III paired with coach Mike Macdonald's Dark Side defense led to the organization's second Super Bowl championship.


              That was a team more ready to win than Las Vegas, which is showing signs of progress, having already surpassed its three wins from last season. The Raiders average 26.4 points per game, eighth in the NFL, after reaching that number just once in 2025.


              “They’re building it around the people that they have and they’re doing it at a high level,” Macdonald said. “I respect how they operate, obviously, and they have great people and good players. They’re moving the ball and putting up a lot of points.”


              Macdonald and his staff don't have much video on Mendoza, who has made just one appearance. Mendoza completed 6 of 8 passes for 48 yards late in a blowout loss to New England.


              There is a lot of pressure on Mendoza, who has been in the spotlight since winning the Heisman Trophy last season and leading Indiana to the national championship.


              He has acknowledged a big learning curve, and the Raiders brought Mendoza along slowly while Cousins ran the offense. Word from the Raiders' locker room was Mendoza made the most of that time and put together some outstanding practices in recent weeks.


              “Sometimes coach Sully (QBs coach Mike Sullivan) will reference back to ‘Spring Fernando,’” Mendoza said. “I don’t want to talk about myself in the third person, but it just shows how much improvement there’s been. I’m a lot more confident as a quarterback, and I feel more developed.”

articles.headline: Sources: Bulls' Caleb Wilson to have surgery on fractured hand, miss 4-6 weeks
articles.description: Bulls rookie Caleb Wilson will undergo surgery for a fractured right hand and miss four to six weeks, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania.
articles.headlineJa: 【情報】ブルズのカレブ・ウィルソン、手の骨折で手術へ、4〜6週間欠場
articles.descriptionJa: ブルズのルーキー、カレブ・ウィルソンが右手の骨折により手術を受け、4〜6週間欠場することが、ESPNのシャムス・チャラニア記者への関係者の話で分かった。
articles.body:
Chicago Bulls rookie Caleb Wilson will have surgery on his fractured right hand and miss four to six weeks, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania.

Wilson injured his hand during the third quarter of Wednesday's 124-119 loss to the San Antonio Spurs when he tried to knock the ball out of Victor Wembanyama's hands. Wilson did not finish the game. He is scheduled to undergo surgery on Thursday.

Wilson, the No. 4 pick in the 2026 draft, had been one of the bright spots for the Bulls during a 1-9 start. The 20-year-old rookie was averaging 18.9 points, 6.2 rebounds and 1.9 assists on 42% shooting in his first 10 games.

Chicago underwent a franchise overhaul over the summer, hiring Bryson Graham as the team's new lead executive and Tiago Splitter as its new head coach. But Wilson was drafted to be the franchise's face on the court. Much of Chicago's offense already ran through their first-year player. Wilson ranked second on the team in scoring (behind veteran guard Norman Powell), but first in shot attempts (16.2) while adding 1.8 steals and 0.9 blocks per game.

During his lone season at North Carolina, Wilson missed the NCAA tournament after he required surgery to repair a broken right thumb. He also missed six games in college with a broken bone in his left hand.

The Bulls own the league's worst net rating at minus 15.1 and now are facing an extended absence from their top prospect. Chicago will host the Atlanta Hawks on Friday.

articles.headline: Transfer rumors, news: Liverpool eye move for Brentford's Diouf
articles.description: Could Brentford's El Hadji Malick Diouf be the latest signing at Anfield? Transfer Talk has the latest.
articles.body:
Liverpool are interested in Brentford full back El Hadji Malick Diouf, while AFC Bournemouth midfielder Alex Scott has caught the eye of Arsenal, Chelsea and Liverpool. Join us for the latest transfer news and rumors from around the globe.

Transfers home page | Men's summer grades | Women's grades

Trending rumors

- Liverpool are interested in Brentford full back El Hadji Malick Diouf, Football Insider reports. The Reds are keen to strengthen on the left side of their defense in January amid concerns over the consistency over Milos Kerkez, and the 21-year-old Senegal international is one of the options being monitored despite the fact it could be difficult to persuade the Bees to part ways with him. Diouf arrived at the club from West Ham United for a fee of around £40 million in the summer.

- Arsenal will challenge Chelsea and Liverpool for the signing of AFC Bournemouth midfielder Alex Scott, according to iNews. The Gunners are the latest of the three clubs to make an inquiry about the 23-year-old ahead of a possible move in January, when it is thought an offer worth £80m would be enough for the Cherries to enter formal negotiations. Scott has indicated that he is unwilling to extend his stay at the Vitality Stadium, which makes the upcoming transfer window one of the final opportunities for him to be moved on for the highest possible fee.

- Napoli are tracking Chelsea winger Jamie Gittens amid plans to reinforce their forward line in the next transfer window, according to Corriere dello Sport. Gittens, 22, is being considered as a loan option and is among several players that the Serie A club could approach following a disappointing start to the season, in which they are currently 10th in the league table. He has made just two appearances for the Blues this season.

- Barcelona are interested in FC Twente defender Ruud Nijstad, Diario Sport reports. Barcleona sporting director Deco has already begun work on a move for the 18-year-old as the Blaugrana look to land a left-footed defender with strong ball-playing ability, though the Eredivisie side are set to demand a proposal worth €20m before agreeing to a deal. Nijstad was recently called up to Netherlands' U21 squad.

- PSV Eindhoven have made an inquiry for Napoli midfielder Kevin De Bruyne, according to Nicolò Schira. It is reported that the 35-year-old could leave the Serie A club in the next few months, with PSV checking on his situation ahead of an approach in January. De Bruyne's deal is set to expire next summer, but there is an option clause that would allow Gli Azzurri to extend it by a further year.

articles.headline: 76ers Joel Embiid (foot) questionable, LeBron James (back) out vs. Raptors
articles.description: 76ers center Joel Embiid is questionable for Thursday night's game against the Raptors with right foot plantar fascia management. LeBron James is out with lower back/sciatica management.
articles.headlineJa: 76ersのジョエル・エンビード（足）は出場不透明、レブロン・ジェームズ（腰）はラプターズ戦を欠場
articles.descriptionJa: 76ersのセンター、ジョエル・エンビードは右足の足底筋膜の管理のため、木曜夜のラプターズ戦への出場が不透明です。レブロン・ジェームズは腰部および坐骨神経の管理のため欠場します。
articles.body:
PHILADELPHIA -- Philadelphia 76ers center Joel Embiid, who is questionable for Thursday night's game against the Toronto Raptors with right foot plantar fascia management, said he has "no idea" if he'll play.

"We'll see what they have to say and then we'll go from there," Embiid said, referring to the Sixers' medical staff.

LeBron James, who was ruled out with lower back/sciatica management, was among the last players on the floor after shootaround, taking free throws.

James, who turns 42 next month, will now have four to five days off before he plays again. The Sixers are off Friday and Saturday. They have back-to-back games Sunday and Monday. James typically does not play in least one game of a back-to-back set so he could return Sunday against Indiana or Monday at Brooklyn.

James has averaged 15.1 points, 7.2 rebounds and 6.5 assists in 10 games for the Sixers this season.

Embiid has missed two games this season to manage his fascia injury, and the Sixers are 1-1 in his absence.

The Sixers would be significantly shorthanded in the frontcourt if Embiid is out. Big man Adem Bona (cervical spine sprain) and Dominick Barlow (back) have already been ruled out.

On this new-look Sixers team, Embiid has struggled the most to look like himself. He's begun this season with averages in points (17.7) and three-point percentage (12.1%) that would be career lows.

"I just haven't been aggressive," he said Thursday. "So I think it's on me to just be aggressive about making plays, whether it's making plays for someone else."

Information from The Associated Press was used in this report.

ESPN's basketball daily cheat sheet is your pregame destination before you lock in daily fantasy and betting decisions for that night's games. Here you'll find our top insights for the slate, including players to target for your daily fantasy rosters, along with game-by-game injury reports.

-->
What you need to know for Thursday

Coming off a 43-point performance against the Indiana Pacers, Cooper Flagg and the Dallas Mavericks visit the Minnesota Timberwolves in one of the top matchups on Thursday's four-game slate. Dallas (7-4) has won three straight, and Minnesota (8-3) has won four in a row despite injuries to Anthony Edwards and Donte DiVincenzo. LaMelo Ball and Ayo Dosunmu have helped pick up the slack, as the pair combined for 50 points against the Utah Jazz on Sunday.

The Detroit Pistons visit the Washington Wizards just three days after beating them 122-111. Detroit (7-3) will again be without Jalen Duren, while Daniss Jenkins looks to build on Monday's performance when he finished with 22 points, eight assists and four steals. Elsewhere, the Philadelphia 76ers (9-3) host a Toronto Raptors team playing its second game in as many nights without Scottie Barnes and Kawhi Leonard.

Let's take a closer look at Thursday's matchups, along with some fantasy streamers and betting angles worth considering.

 Jakob Poeltl, C, Raptors (45.3%)

Poeltl has played at least 31 minutes in three straight games -- a positive sign after his minutes were limited earlier this season -- and averaged 14.3 PPG, 9.0 RPG and 2.0 blocks during that stretch. The 76ers have Joel Embiid in their frontcourt, so Toronto will need Poeltl's size. He's worth streaming for rebounds, blocks and field-goal percentage, although his six-point performance against the Boston Celtics on Wednesday is a reminder that his scoring can fluctuate.

 Paul Reed, PF/C, Pistons (37.2%)

Reed remains viable with Duren sidelined, particularly for managers chasing rebounds and defensive stats. He has pulled down 10-plus rebounds in consecutive games, including Monday's matchup against the Wizards when he also recorded three blocks and a steal. Reed averages 11.4 PPG and 7.4 RPG this season, but he moved to the bench Monday and played just 21 minutes, which limits his ceiling. Still, he's worth considering in category leagues, especially if the Pistons give him additional frontcourt minutes.

articles.headline: Barcelona fan for life -- and beyond: Fans can pay to deposit ashes at Camp Nou
articles.description: Barcelona are giving their fans the possibility to be part of the club once they pass away by offering from 2027 a columbarium and commemorative plaques at their stadium.
articles.body:
Barcelona are giving their fans the possibility to be part of the club once they pass away by offering from 2027 a columbarium and commemorative plaques at their stadium.

As part of the upgrade to Camp Nou, Barça will have a 1,500m² Memorial space consisting of commemorative plaques and 26,000 niches, where fans' ashes can be deposited.

Both the columbarium and commemorative plaques come with concessions lasting for 10, 25 or 50-year periods. Both options are available to Barça fans worldwide as there is no need to be a club member.

"Two ways of paying tribute and showing remembrance will be available through placing a loved one's ashes in a columbarium or writing a name and message on a commemorative plaque in the Stadium. Both options are available to FC Barcelona fans worldwide, there is no need to be a member," a club statement said.

A peaceful resting place at the Camp Nou will cost from €2,490 ($2,762) for a 10-year concession while the 50-year concession will set you back €5,990 ($6,644). In addition, there is a maintenance fee of €70 per year. A standard 10-year plaque is €490 while a 50-year premium one is €1,040.

Designed by architect Quique Montoya, the Memorial space will combine "fine materials, warm lighting and a contemporary style, with large murals dedicated to notable moments in Barça's history, plus visual, audiovisual and sound elements."

The work, which is being carried out in two phases, will be completed in mid-2028.

"Many fans, members and those with a past at the Club have shown interest in the FC Barcelona Memorial since the launch of the project," the club said.

"These include several former players and relatives of historic figures at Barça who have shown their desire to form part of the initiative."
